$schema-note: THE URL allowlist - this is the only whitelist file. Location: ~/.config/little-coder/url-whitelist.json (override with LITTLE_CODER_URL_WHITELIST=/path; there is no cwd or multi-path lookup). Pattern forms: 'example.com' (exact host, any path), '*.example.com' (apex + any subdomain), 'example.com/docs' (host + path prefix), or a full URL (scheme pinned). Covers webfetch, websearch, browser tools (including link clicks, form posts, meta/JS redirects, redirect hops and back-navigations inside the browser; LITTLE_CODER_URL_GATE_BROWSER=main-frame|all|off picks how far into a page that reaches), webfetch redirect hops, and any http(s) URL named inside a shell command. Anything not matched asks you (LITTLE_CODER_URL_GATE=ask|block|off).
$add-a-host: append the hostname to the array below, e.g. "reddit.com", "*.reddit.com"; the file is re-read on change, no restart needed
$do-not-add: Two classes of host must stay off this list. (1) Proxy / reader / mirror hosts defeat the allowlist entirely, because they fetch an ARBITRARY URL for the model: r.jina.ai, s.jina.ai, web.archive.org, *.archive.org, Google cache and transcode hosts, allorigins.win, corsproxy.io, 12ft.io, and any 'extract / read / proxy' SaaS. (2) Attacker-writable content hosts make 'that host is allowed' meaningless, because anyone can put a page there: *.github.io, *.githubusercontent.com, public CDNs (unpkg, jsdelivr, *.cloudfront.net), pastebins, transfer.sh, *.ngrok.io, *.s3.amazonaws.com. URL shorteners are pointless to add on top of that — redirect hops are re-checked.
$what-it-is-not: A policy surface with a human in the loop, not a sandbox. Invisible at the tool layer, by construction: a script that makes its own HTTP calls (python3 crawler.py), package-manager traffic (pip / npm / apt) whose URL the model never typed, and a shell fetcher's own redirect hops (curl -L). Non-http(s) forms are invisible to shell scanning too — git@github.com:…, ssh://, and scheme-less URLs. A hard boundary needs ufw / iptables owner rules or a proxy allowlist, not this file.
$pattern-limits: Hosts, '*.host', host+path-prefix or a full URL. Exact IPs only: there is no IP-wildcard form, so '192.168.40.*' does not work — name the exact address, or fence the network.
